title: The Notebook the Sea Gave Back
story_text:
Mara lived in a small town by the sea and worked at a marine station, where she kept records of fish and water. One morning she found a wet notebook on the rocks. It was not up to date — the last page was dated forty years ago — but it held careful notes about the bay. It was evident that someone had watched the water for years.

Mara wanted to find the writer. She asked older neighbors and, one week later, met an old man living in a blue house on the hill. He smiled and said the notebook was his. He was fortunate, he added, that the sea had returned it before he forgot it. Together they added the new year's counts, and Mara wrote her first note beside his.
translation_zh:
玛拉住在海边的一座小镇，在一家海洋研究站工作，记录鱼和海水的情况。一天早晨，她在岩石上发现一本湿透的笔记本。这本笔记不是最新的——最后一页写的是四十年前的日期——但里面记着关于这个海湾的细心记录。很明显，有人观察这片海水已经很多年。

玛拉想找到写笔记的人。她问了年纪较大的邻居，一周后，遇到一位住在山上蓝色房子里的老人。他笑着说，笔记本是他的。他还说，他很幸运，大海在他忘记它之前把本子还了回来。他们一起补上了新一年的记录，玛拉把自己写的第一条笔记，写在了他的字旁边。
